Diagnostic Graphs of a Fitted Model

Source: R/plot_core.R
diagnostics.Rd

Draws a set of diagnostic_plot graphs of a fit and returns them as a named list of ggplot2 objects, or composed in one figure. The default set is the observed density of the response with the densities of simulated responses (plot_ppc()), the worm plot (plot_worm()), the calibration of the predicted quantiles (plot_calibration()) and the quantile residuals against the predicted median (plot_residuals() with against = "median"). None of the four reads a particular parameter, so the set applies to every family, including those without a location parameter.

Usage

diagnostics(fit, plot_types = NULL, data = NULL, compose = FALSE)

Arguments

fit

A StatmodFit().

plot_types

A list of objects inheriting from diagnostic_plot, or NULL for the default set.

data

The data frame of the fit, or NULL; it is required by the graphs that read a covariate.

compose

Whether to compose the graphs in one figure with patchwork.

Value

A named list of ggplot2 objects, or a patchwork object when compose = TRUE.

See also

autoplot.StatmodFit(), diagnostic_plot

Examples

set.seed(1)
dd <- data.frame(x = runif(150))
dd$y <- 1 + dd$x + rnorm(150, sd = 0.4)
fit <- statmod(y ~ x, distributions7::gaussian1_distrib(), dd)
d <- diagnostics(fit)
names(d)
#> [1] "ppc"         "worm"        "calibration" "residuals"  
diagnostics(fit, plot_types = list(plot_qq(), plot_pit()), compose = TRUE)
